name: Azorius Ploy

Prevent all combat damage target creature would deal this turn.
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage target creature would deal this turn.
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn.

needs.what: a combat_only flag on the prevent_damage_permanent op, so a one-shot shield installed by a resolving spell on a targeted permanent (dealt 'by' or 'to', duration this_turn) prevents only combat damage and lets noncombat damage through
needs.why_existing_wont_do: prevent_damage_permanent takes only objects, dealt and duration and prevents ALL damage, so it would also stop burn and fight damage; the prevent_damage static has combat_only but lives on a printed permanent, has no 'this turn' duration, cannot be installed by a spell, and only stops damage dealt to what it matches, never damage a creature would deal
